name: AI Content Translation
description: Provides AI-powered content translation using OpenAI.
project_description: AI Content Translation adds one-click, AI-generated translations of Drupal content entities using OpenAI's chat-completions API, layered on top of core's content_translation workflow. It exposes an "AI Translate to <language>" operation on entity listings and an "Add AI Translation" action on the per-entity Translations tab, plus a "Generate AI Translation" button on the translation add form. For a chosen target language it copies the source entity, then sends each translatable text value (title, body, other text/string fields, image alt/title attributes) to OpenAI one field at a time and writes the returned text into the new translation, preserving each field's text format. It recurses into referenced content entities and Paragraphs so structured content is translated as a whole, while deliberately skipping file, media and taxonomy_term references and non-text fields (datetime, numeric, list). Configuration is a single settings form holding the OpenAI API key, model (GPT-4 / GPT-4 Turbo / GPT-3.5 Turbo), a customisable system prompt, temperature, request/connect timeouts and logging verbosity. A single restricted permission, 'administer ai content translation', governs both the settings form and the translate action. Requires an OpenAI API key; source and translated text are sent to OpenAI, so consider data sensitivity and per-request cost.
